title: 第124章 先接谁
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“把门岗电话报过来。”

马昊抄下号码，立刻用分诊台旁边那部座机回拨。

几秒后，电话接通，马昊先报了身份。

“市一院急诊。刚才让你们找那个蓝色工装、骑车的人，找到了？”

门岗那边连寒暄都省了。

“找到了，坐在我们小区门口台阶边。”

赵护士手里的腕带贴到一半，边角还翘着。

她抬头冲着免提问：“人还清醒吗？”

门岗像是刚从外头跑回来，话里还带着喘。

“叫他能答应，就是一直说胸口堵，想吐。嘴唇有点紫。旁边还放着半盒凉拌牛肉，他不让我碰，说花了钱的，等会儿还要找摊主说理。”

孙志强直接接过话。

“盒子别让他拿，菜别倒。让人坐着，别站起来，别喝水，也别催吐。120到之前，你就看两件事，叫不叫得应，嘴唇有没有更灰。”

门岗急了。

“我一个保安，哪会看这个？”

“不会也得看。”孙志强把话说得很重，“你现在离他最近。”

门岗被这句咽住，过了两秒才应了一声。

急诊这头也没给人喘气的空。

夜市男孩那边刚换过氧气管，儿科医生连椅子都没坐。刚才嘴硬的中年男人被护士按回床栏，心电导联还没贴稳，又催着问自己什么时候能走。

分诊护士捂着另一只听筒，把话往这边递。

“东苑那个小姑娘已经在车上，往医院这边来了。郭姐夫妻也刚上车，说是丈夫吐得厉害。”

这句话刚落，分诊台旁边那部电话又响了。

分诊护士接起来听了几句，立刻回头。

“孙老师，东苑那辆车快到院了。蓝色工装那边，最近一辆车还要七八分钟。”

偏偏红区能立刻空出来的床，只剩一张。

赵护士抬头看向免提。

“七八分钟？他坐得住吗？”

林野没有立刻插话，目光落在蓝色工装那一栏。

视野角落里，淡蓝色字迹亮了一下。

【风险线索：蓝色工装。】

【关键问题：人还在小区门口，菜还没封存。】

【能追的线索：门岗、半盒剩菜、现场照片。】

林野抬头，对着免提问：“师傅，那盒菜现在谁看着？”

门岗那边没反应过来。

“啊？”

“他还攥着盒子，还是已经放下了？”林野语速快了些。

门岗像是把手机拿远了，冲那边喊了两句，中间还夹着一句“你先别动那盒子”。

再回来时，他声音都变了。

“还搁他脚边呢。他说那是证据，谁碰都不行。”

马昊抄到一半，腕带上的字斜出去一截。

“还当证据？”

赵护士抬眼看向免提，声音里火气还没散。

“都这样了，还惦记着找人吵架。”

林野想起前几天那个工地五床。

脚踝肿得鞋都穿不上，人还攥着工具箱钥匙，怕少一把扳手说不清。

蓝色工装护着那半盒菜，大概也是怕说不清。

可这东西不能再让人碰。

林野看向孙志强。

“孙老师，不能光接人。”

孙志强转头看他。

"Give the door guard the phone number."

Ma Hao copied the number and immediately called back on the landline next to the triage table.

A few seconds later, the call was connected, and Ma Hao reported his identity first.

"Emergency Department of the First City Hospital. I asked you to look for the man in blue overalls and riding a bicycle just now. Did you find him?"

Even greetings were omitted at the gate.

"I found it, sitting by the steps at the door of our community."

The wristband in Nurse Zhao's hand was attached halfway, with the corners still raised.

She raised her head and asked, "Is he still conscious?"

Mengang seemed to have just ran back from outside, and he was still breathing heavily when he spoke.

"I told him to agree, but he kept saying that his chest was blocked and he felt like vomiting. His lips were a bit purple. There was half a box of cold beef next to it, but he wouldn't let me touch it. He said he spent money on it and would have to talk to the stall owner later to reason."

Sun Zhiqiang took the call directly.

"Don't let him take the box, don't pour the dishes. Let him sit down, don't stand up, don't drink water, and don't induce vomiting. Before 120, you have to pay attention to two things: whether the scream is responded to, and whether the lips are grayer."

The gate guard was in a hurry.

"How can I, a security guard, read this?"

"You have to watch even if you don't know." Sun Zhiqiang said seriously, "You are closest to him now."

Mengang was choked by this sentence, and it took two seconds before he responded.

There is no room for breathing in the emergency department.

The boy at the night market had just had his oxygen tube replaced, and the pediatrician didn't even have a chair.The middle-aged man who had just spoken harshly was pushed back to the bed rail by the nurse. The ECG leads were not yet securely attached, and he was urged to ask when he could leave.

The triage nurse covered the other receiver and handed the words over.

"The little girl from Dongyuan is already in the car and coming to the hospital. Sister Guo and his wife have just gotten in the car and said that her husband had severe vomiting."

As soon as he said this, the phone next to the triage table rang again.

The triage nurse picked up the conversation, listened to a few words, and immediately turned back.

"Teacher Sun, the car from Dongyuan is almost at the hospital. Over there in the blue overalls, the nearest car will take seven or eight minutes."

Unfortunately, there was only one bed left that could be immediately vacated in the red zone.

Nurse Zhao looked up at the speakerphone.

"Seven or eight minutes? Can he sit still?"

Lin Ye didn't interrupt immediately, his eyes fell on the column of blue overalls.

In the corner of the field of vision, light blue writing lit up.

[Risk clue: blue overalls.】

[Key issue: People are still at the gate of the community, and the food has not been sealed yet.】

[Clues that can be followed: Gate post, half a box of leftovers, photos of the scene.】

Lin Ye raised his head and asked Fu Fu: "Master, who is looking after that box of vegetables now?"

There was no response from the gate guard.

"Huh?"

"Is he still holding the box, or has he put it down?" Lin Ye spoke faster.

The gatekeeper seemed to have put his cell phone away and shouted a few words to the other side, including "Don't touch that box yet."

When he came back, his voice had changed.

"It's still at his feet. He said it was evidence and no one could touch it."

Ma Hao was halfway through copying, and the words on the wristband were tilted out.

"Still as evidence?"

Nurse Zhao looked up at the speakerphone, the anger in her voice not dissipating.

"This is already the case, and you still want to find someone to quarrel with."

Lin Ye thought of the five-bed building at the construction site a few days ago.

His ankles were so swollen that he couldn't even put on his shoes, and he was still clutching the toolbox key for fear of missing a wrench.

The blue overalls were protecting the half box of vegetables, probably because they were afraid of not being able to tell clearly.

But no one can touch this thing again.

Lin Ye looked at Sun Zhiqiang.

"Teacher Sun, you can't just pick up people."

Sun Zhiqiang turned to look at him.
